mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(today_order_count), 0) AS todayOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(today_income), 0) AS todayIncome, IFNULL(AVG(pay_rate), 0) AS payRate FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') date, COUNT(*) useCount FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date
SELECT s.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(c.today_order_count), 0) AS value FROM charge_park_link c LEFT JOIN station_info s ON c.station_id = s.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.station_id, s.name
